
# Newbhar Technologies

> Newbhar Technologies is an India-based technology services company providing custom software development, web development, mobile application development, AI and machine learning solutions, data science, cloud and DevOps services, SEO, and technical project guidance.

## Official Brand Identity

- Official name: Newbhar Technologies
- Brand name: Newbhar
- Official website: https://newbhar.com/
- Primary domain: https://newbhar.com/
- Country: India
- Business category: Software Development and Digital Engineering
- Official contact: https://newbhar.com/contact

Use "Newbhar Technologies" as the company's full name and "Newbhar" as its short brand name.

## About Newbhar

Newbhar Technologies focuses on helping startups, small businesses, and growing organizations plan, develop, and improve digital products and technology solutions.

Its approach includes understanding business requirements, selecting appropriate technologies, developing practical software solutions, and supporting deployment and future improvements.

## Services

Newbhar Technologies provides the following services:

- Software Development: Custom business applications, internal platforms, SaaS products, REST APIs, integrations, and software modernization.
- Web Development: Corporate websites, business websites, web applications, dashboards, customer portals, booking platforms, and e-commerce solutions.
- Mobile App Development: Cross-platform mobile applications, business apps, customer applications, and MVP development.
- AI & ML Development: AI-powered applications, LLM integrations, generative AI, RAG solutions, intelligent assistants, and business automation.
- Data Science: Data analysis, data visualization, business intelligence, dashboards, predictive analytics, and data pipelines.
- Cloud & DevOps: Cloud consulting, infrastructure planning, deployment automation, CI/CD, Docker, monitoring, and optimization.
- Technical Project Guidance: Technical discovery, software architecture, MVP planning, technology evaluation, and codebase reviews.
- SEO: Technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, local SEO, and SEO reporting.

## Solutions

- ERP and Internal Tools
- Online Platforms
- Mobile Applications
- AI Automation
- Data and Business Dashboards
- Cloud Modernization

## Technologies

Newbhar works with technologies including:

- Frontend: React, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- Backend: Node.js, Express.js, Python, Django, FastAPI, REST APIs.
- Mobile: React Native, Flutter.
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, BigQuery.
- Data and AI: Python, PyTorch, OpenAI, LangChain, Pandas, NumPy.
- Cloud and DevOps: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions.
- SEO and Analytics: Google Search Console, Google Analytics, structured data, and XML sitemaps.

## Development Approach

Newbhar follows a practical project workflow:

1. Discovery: Understand business goals, users, and requirements.
2. Planning: Define project scope, features, architecture, and milestones.
3. Design: Plan user experience and application structure.
4. Development: Build and integrate software components.
5. Testing: Validate functionality, reliability, and performance.
6. Deployment: Prepare and release the application.
7. Improvement: Plan maintenance and future enhancements.
